behaviors.description: Enumerate typed unused and pinned refs with architecture filters.
behaviors.preconditions: App using runtime/SDK and an unpinned extension; separate unused runtime; native and foreign pinned runtimes.
behaviors.expected: Exact unused and pinned membership for unrestricted, native, foreign and absent architectures; every returned element is an installed ref.

behaviors.description: Observe installation monitor notifications for direct lifecycle changes.
behaviors.preconditions: New public monitor connected before each install, update and uninstall; runtime satisfied and remote selected before monitoring.
behaviors.expected: Each operation produces a changed notification while main context is serviced and the expected deployment outcome.

behaviors.description: Control retention of files used by a running app during uninstall.
behaviors.preconditions: Held-live independent app probe; an open descriptor identifies its deployment across directory renames.
behaviors.expected: Both uninstalls remove installed identity; ordinary uninstall retains running files, force_uninstall removes them; process is killed and reaped.

behaviors.description: Read release and rating fields from actual deployed AppStream.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent rich Query app and QuerySecond without optional AppStream fields.
behaviors.expected: Exact version, MIT license, oars-1.1 type and single violence-cartoon=none attribute; all optional getters NULL for second app.

behaviors.description: Read actual installed and remote end-of-life metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent transaction A, EOL and REBASE commits.
behaviors.expected: Both typed refs expose absent, reason-only and reason-plus-full-rebase values matching independent exports.

behaviors.preconditions: CLI launches independent runtime probe and reports instance ID; probe confirms execution before inspection.
behaviors.expected: Exactly that live instance reports NULL app, expected runtime and runtime commit; sandbox is explicitly killed and reaped.

behaviors.description: Check public deployment preservation across cleanup and pruning.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent deployed and pulled-only apps; positive no-pull deployment control for the second app before resetting it to pulled-only state.
behaviors.expected: Cleanup and prune succeed; no-pull install of the cleaned ref fails before and after pruning; deployed app and runtime commits stay intact. Orphaned-object deletion is not established.

behaviors.description: Defer and explicitly refresh exported MIME associations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent desktop app A/B with different MIME types; desktop MIME trigger installed.
behaviors.expected: NO_TRIGGERS install/update/uninstall leaves cache unchanged until public run_triggers produces A/B/absent association respectively.

mappings.rationale: Typed results exclude the app, its used runtime/SDK and unpinned related extension; include only the separate unused runtime; pinned native/foreign refs and all architecture filters checked exactly.
Independent monitor registration immediately before each direct lifecycle operation, with context-driven event delivery and exact deployment checks.
Additional public force_uninstall contract has no exact row in the fixed denominator; held running files distinguish TRUE from FALSE.
Real rich and field-absent deployments exercise all four typed getters including exact attribute membership and NULL cases.
Both typed installed and remote getters checked against independently exported absent, EOL-only and rebase metadata.
Synchronized actual runtime sandbox selected by launch-reported instance ID has NULL application getter.

Layout-independent partial check: cleanup and pruning preserve deployments and the cleaned ref cannot be installed without pulling. The orphaned-objects obligation is withheld because actual object reclamation is unobserved.
Install/update/uninstall NO_TRIGGERS observed against real exported desktop MIME cache; run_triggers must refresh each deferred change.
